api_changes.detail: The quickstart shows an OpenAI client with base_url https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/ and POST https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/chat/completions. It also shows Authorization: Bearer $NEBIUS_API_KEY. This sample keeps that base_url.

The November 2026 deprecations page says to update the model and base_url values. This sample only changes the model field. Token Factory does not automatically reroute requests from deprecated models. Dedicated Endpoints are unaffected.

code_change.before:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/")
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)
code_change.after:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/")
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)
